Subscription plans overview
Reve plans are designed to be clear and simple. We currently offer 3 plans - Free, Lite and Pro. Each plan provides a set amount of creative energy and storage.
After initial sign up, Free accounts receive an introductory allocation of creative energy and a daily refresh thereafter.
The Lite subscription offers 5x more energy than Free , and Pro subscription offers 100x more energy than Free. Lite and Pro are billed monthly and can be cancelled at any time via your Account tab.
